A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of Self-diffusion for Solving Inverse Problems, including Appendices A–F. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original signal-recovery simulations and MRI, radar, and image-restoration experiments in Sections 3–4, with additional reconstruction results in Appendices D–F.

after.justification: v2 retains the original simulations and experimental results in Sections 3–4 and Appendices D–F, including quantitative comparisons and qualitative reconstructions.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same self-diffusion procedure, noise schedule, single continuously trained denoiser, and data-fidelity objective. The task-specific network adaptations are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same compressed-sensing simulation, fastMRI and volumetric MRI data, RADIal radar scenes, ImageNet restoration tasks, CBSD68 denoising, and large-image restoration example.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within every experiment: ADMM-BP and DIP for signal recovery; IMJENSE, Aseq, DIP, and CSGM in the corresponding MRI comparisons; and the same restoration, denoising, and runtime comparators in Tables 3–6.

E3.justification: The same sample sizes, preprocessing, measurement operators, reconstruction settings, optimization budgets, and metrics appear in both versions. This includes the 80-subject fastMRI evaluation, 1,000-image ImageNet evaluation, and Appendix E 3D MRI protocol.

E4.justification: The noise-resampling ablations, cross-contrast MRI comparison, K/T sensitivity analysis in Table 5, reconstruction progression in Appendix D, and qualitative case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Both versions present the same point estimates without experimental repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–6 and results in Figures 1–15 are unchanged, including appendix reconstructions. For example, Table 1 retains SDI PSNR values of 39.21 and 36.84 for 4× and 6× MRI reconstruction.

T1.justification: Section 2 and Appendices A–C preserve the same mathematical formulations, ideal-denoiser assumptions, error analysis, continuous-time approximation, and Jacobian/Fourier regularization derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical novelty, theoretical-contribution, and performance claims, including reconstruction without pretrained models or external training data.

C2.justification: The spectral-bias interpretation, claimed advantages over DIP, and future directions are unchanged. Both versions retain the qualification that the CSGM comparison does not establish general superiority over pretrained diffusion methods.

D1.justification: Architectures, initialization, hyperparameters, preprocessing commands, hardware/runtime information, and code/project access links are unchanged. The new acknowledgement adds no implementation or reproducibility details.

R1.justification: Both versions contain the same 30 references and identical positioning relative to prior work. Bibliography entries are redistributed across pages without citation additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Acknowledgements section after the conclusion, crediting the Luxembourg Institute of Health and FNR support for the NeurIPS rebuttal. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; the research prose and existing section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The new acknowledgement shifts the bibliography layout across pages 10–12. All 15 figures and six tables retain their displays, captions, and positions, including those in the appendices.

improvement.justification: v2 adds institutional and funding credit for rebuttal support and slightly reflows the references. These changes do not meaningfully alter readability, scientific support, or reproducibility; the methods, results, theoretical arguments, and appendices remain unchanged.
